surface: heart-v2-launch-reconciler (reconcile_heart_green_light_once + launch_real + the rc-agent active_games state channel)
author: bono

Q1_atomic_primitives.note: Reconciler snapshots active_games (RwLock read, heart_v2.rs:923-937) then applies idempotent heart mutations under a separate write lock (:986-995); TOCTOU called safe (:984-985). BUT the input active_games has no per-entry liveness/recency stamp — an empty map is indistinguishable from 'all agents disconnected' (the root defect).

Q2_ttl_sentinels.note: No startup-grace / agent-last-seen TTL gates the Exit decision. None-agent-view arm (:976) fires immediately with no 'agent had T seconds to reconnect+report' sentinel.

Q3_behavioral_verify.note: Launch verify is behavioral (waits for real GameState::Running, not echo) BUT verify_timeout (default_verify_timeout AC=30s, game_launcher_ops.rs:550-555) < cold AC launch, so a true late-Running is discarded after the heart declares failure.

Q4_single_target_dryrun.note: launch_real is per-pod (single-target), but the reconciler is fleet-wide with no per-pod observe-only/dry-run; a guard bug ends ALL billed pods at once.

Q5_written_guard_contracts.note: Failure arm (:827-840) issues no StopGame back to the agent; no written contract that 'heart abandoned launch => agent stops game.' Heart and agent silently diverge.

verdict: Q2 + Q5 FAIL, Q1/Q3/Q4 PARTIAL. Two structural holes: (i) no agent-presence/recency gate on termination decisions; (ii) no heart->agent StopGame contract on launch abandonment. These are load-bearing design fixes (RCA §5/§7), not a one-line patch.

mma_step1.consensus: TWO-TIMER model: short GRACE (~20-60s, ws_connected+connected-duration) gates the EXIT arm; separate long T_terminate (~10-30min) ends sustained-absence sessions as ABANDONED with billing CAPPED to last-positive-contact. Slow-launch fix = (b) keep recoverable pending-verify + reconciler resolves on positive agent truth + StopGame on abandon (unanimous). Flapping => gate on cumulative-absence not per-connection grace. Heart emits in_grace/abandoned to billing proxy + persist/retry StopGame.
